title: inference — numb

sentences.sentence: There were two inferences to be drawn from her letter.
sentences.translation: 从她的来信可以得到两种推论。

sentences.sentence: the adversarial nature of two-party politics
sentences.translation: 两党政治的对抗性

sentences.sentence: The implication is that you may need to track all changes to your process, the reason why you made each change, and when the change was made to conform to these regulations.
sentences.translation: 这含义是您可能需要追踪对您的过程进行的所有的变更，您为什么进行每个变更的原因，以及为了遵守这些法规，什么时候进行的变更。

sentences.sentence: an intimate friend of Picasso’s
sentences.translation: 毕加索的一个密友

sentences.sentence: an intimate relationship
sentences.translation: 亲密的关系

sentences.sentence: She’s on intimate terms with people in government.
sentences.translation: 她与政府官员关系密切。

sentences.sentence: The flies leave a sticky residue on crops.
sentences.translation: 苍蝇在庄稼上留下黏糊糊的分泌物。

sentences.sentence: Rinse off any soap residue.
sentences.translation: 冲净残留的肥皂。

sentences.sentence: Of course I wonder if happiness tactics that come from someone elsecan ever stick.
sentences.translation: 当然我怀疑来自与某人的快乐策略是否对其他人有用。

sentences.sentence: I think it will also point to areas where we can do better and can make improvements in our strategy and tactics," he said.
sentences.translation: 我认为，报告还会指出在哪些领域我们能够做得更好，还有我们可以在哪些领域提高我们的策略和战术。

sentences.sentence: The essence of dialectical thought is division.
sentences.translation: 辩证思想的实质是二分法。

sentences.sentence: Three students were mentioned, namely John, Sarah and Sylvia.
sentences.translation: 有三名学生被提到，即约翰、萨拉和西尔维娅。

phrases.translation: 典范转移；思考模式的转移

sentences.sentence: ...a new paradigm of production.
sentences.translation: …一种新的生产范例。

sentences.sentence: The issue has polarized the country.
sentences.translation: 这个问题使整个国家变得两极化。

sentences.sentence: Halsey was identified as a leading proponent of the values of progressive education.
sentences.translation: 哈尔西被认为是进步教育价值观的首要支持者。

sentences.sentence: By using a Recovery Protocol, we can stay in synch with our overall vision, values, and goals during the rough times.
sentences.translation: 通过利用恢复协议，在艰难时期，我们可以与我们整个的视界、价值和目标保持同步。

sentences.sentence: If it becomes clear that your systems' times are not in synch, then I suggest you look into the various means available to you for synchronizing them (see  Resources for a link).
sentences.translation: 如果明显看出系统的时间不同步，那么我建议您研究一下可用于同步它们的各种可用途径（请参阅  参考资料以获得链接）。

sentences.sentence: His excuse was the platitude ‘boys will be boys.’
sentences.translation: 他还是那一套理由:“男孩总归是男孩。”

sentences.sentence: He’ll phone on some pretext or other.
sentences.translation: 他会以这样或那样的理由打电话的。

phrases.translation: n. 障碍竞赛；跳栏赛跑

sentences.sentence: Finding enough money for the project was the first hurdle.
sentences.translation: 第一道难关是为该项目筹措足够的资金。

sentences.sentence: ‘You’re a fool,’ she chastised herself.
sentences.translation: “你真傻。”她自责道。

sentences.sentence: speculative investments
sentences.translation: 投机性的投资

sentences.sentence: On Fleet Street, we call it “the mass doorstep” when a crowd of reporters will wait and wait for hours in hope of a tidbit of news on a developing story.
sentences.translation: 在英国新闻界，我们将这种情况称为"守望门庭"，即一群记者长时间地苦苦守候，希望得到一些有关正在发生的事件的消息。

sentences.sentence: Visitors were a rarity in the village.
sentences.translation: 村里极少有外人来。

sentences.sentence: My fingers were so numb I could hardly write.
sentences.translation: 我的手指麻木得几乎没法写字。

sentences.sentence: The anaesthetic made his whole face go numb.
sentences.translation: 麻醉剂使他整个脸都失去了知觉。

text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 6 单元

inference
音标：英 /ˈɪnfərəns/  美 /'ɪnfərəns/
n. 推理； 推断
短语：inference engine — [计]推理机
短语：statistical inference — [统]统计推断
短语：inference method — n. 推理方法
短语：by inference — 根据推理
短语：bayesian inference — 贝叶斯推理
短语：inductive inference — 归纳推理
短语：deductive inference — 演绎推理
短语：inference rule — 推理规则
例句：There were two inferences to be drawn from her letter.
从她的来信可以得到两种推论。

adversarial
音标：英 /ˌædvəˈseəriəl/  美 /,ædvɚ'sɛrɪəl/
adj. 敌手的，对手的
例句：the adversarial nature of two-party politics
两党政治的对抗性

implication
音标：英 /ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃn/  美 /'ɪmplɪ'keʃən/
v. 涉及
短语：by implication — 含蓄地；暗示地
例句：The implication is that you may need to track all changes to your process, the reason why you made each change, and when the change was made to conform to these regulations.
这含义是您可能需要追踪对您的过程进行的所有的变更，您为什么进行每个变更的原因，以及为了遵守这些法规，什么时候进行的变更。

intimate
音标：英 /ˈɪntɪmət/  美 /ˈɪntəmɪt/
adj. 亲密的，亲近的
短语：intimate relationship — 亲密的关系
短语：intimate friend — 知交，知己
短语：intimate contact — 亲密接触
例句：an intimate friend of Picasso’s
毕加索的一个密友
例句：an intimate relationship
亲密的关系
例句：She’s on intimate terms with people in government.
她与政府官员关系密切。

residue
音标：英 /ˈrezɪdju:/  美 /'rɛzɪdu/
n. 残余，残渣
短语：pesticide residue — [药]农药残留（量）
短语：oil residue — 油渣，油残留物；残油
短语：carbon residue — 焦炭残渣；炭渣
短语：filter residue — [化]滤渣
短语：amount of residue — 残留量
短语：amino acid residue — 氨基酸残基
短语：quadratic residue — 二次剩余
短语：solid residue — 固体残渣
例句：The flies leave a sticky residue on crops.
苍蝇在庄稼上留下黏糊糊的分泌物。
例句：Rinse off any soap residue.
冲净残留的肥皂。

tactics
音标：英 /'tæktɪks/  美 /'tæktɪks/
n. 战术； 策略
例句：Of course I wonder if happiness tactics that come from someone elsecan ever stick.
当然我怀疑来自与某人的快乐策略是否对其他人有用。
例句：I think it will also point to areas where we can do better and can make improvements in our strategy and tactics," he said.
我认为，报告还会指出在哪些领域我们能够做得更好，还有我们可以在哪些领域提高我们的策略和战术。

dialectical
音标：英 /ˌdaɪə'lektɪkl/  美 /,daɪə'lɛktɪkl/
adj. 方言的，辩证的
短语：dialectical materialism — n. 辩证唯物主义
例句：The essence of dialectical thought is division.
辩证思想的实质是二分法。

namely
音标：英 /ˈneɪmli/  美 /'nemli/
adv. 即，也就是说
例句：Three students were mentioned, namely John, Sarah and Sylvia.
有三名学生被提到，即约翰、萨拉和西尔维娅。

paradigm
音标：英 /ˈpærədaɪm/  美 /'pærə'daɪm/
n. 范例，样式
短语：paradigm shift — 典范转移；思考模式的转移
例句：...a new paradigm of production.
…一种新的生产范例。

polarize
音标：英 /ˈpəʊləraɪz/  美 /'polə'raɪz/
v. 使两极分化
例句：The issue has polarized the country.
这个问题使整个国家变得两极化。

proponent
音标：英 /prəˈpəʊnənt/  美 /prə'ponənt/
n. 支持者，拥护者
例句：Halsey was identified as a leading proponent of the values of progressive education.
哈尔西被认为是进步教育价值观的首要支持者。

synch
音标：英 /sɪŋk/  美 /siŋk/
v. 同时发生，同步
例句：By using a Recovery Protocol, we can stay in synch with our overall vision, values, and goals during the rough times.
通过利用恢复协议，在艰难时期，我们可以与我们整个的视界、价值和目标保持同步。
例句：If it becomes clear that your systems' times are not in synch, then I suggest you look into the various means available to you for synchronizing them (see  Resources for a link).
如果明显看出系统的时间不同步，那么我建议您研究一下可用于同步它们的各种可用途径（请参阅  参考资料以获得链接）。

platitude
音标：英 /ˈplætɪtju:d/  美 /'plætɪtud/
n. 陈词滥调
例句：His excuse was the platitude ‘boys will be boys.’
他还是那一套理由:“男孩总归是男孩。”

pretext
音标：英 /ˈpri:tekst/  美 /'pritɛkst/
n. 借口，托辞
短语：on the pretext of — 以...为借口
短语：find a pretext for — 为…找口实
例句：He’ll phone on some pretext or other.
他会以这样或那样的理由打电话的。

hurdle
音标：英 /ˈhɜ:dl/  美 /'hɝdl/
n. 障碍，困难
短语：hurdle race — n. 障碍竞赛；跳栏赛跑
例句：Finding enough money for the project was the first hurdle.
第一道难关是为该项目筹措足够的资金。

chastise
音标：英 /tʃæˈstaɪz/  美 /tʃæ'staɪz/
v. 严惩（某人）
例句：‘You’re a fool,’ she chastised herself.
“你真傻。”她自责道。

speculative
音标：英 /ˈspekjələtɪv/  美 /'spɛkjələtɪv/
adj. 投机的； 思考的
短语：speculative capital — 投机资本
短语：speculative knowledge — 理论知识
短语：speculative market — 投机市场
例句：speculative investments
投机性的投资

tidbit
音标：英 /ˈtɪdbɪt/  美 /'tɪd'bɪt/
n. 趣闻
例句：On Fleet Street, we call it “the mass doorstep” when a crowd of reporters will wait and wait for hours in hope of a tidbit of news on a developing story.
在英国新闻界，我们将这种情况称为"守望门庭"，即一群记者长时间地苦苦守候，希望得到一些有关正在发生的事件的消息。

rarity
音标：英 /ˈreərəti/  美 /'rɛrəti/
n. 稀有，罕见
例句：Visitors were a rarity in the village.
村里极少有外人来。

numb
音标：英 /nʌm/  美 /nʌm/
adj. 麻木的，失去感觉的
例句：My fingers were so numb I could hardly write.
我的手指麻木得几乎没法写字。
例句：The anaesthetic made his whole face go numb.
麻醉剂使他整个脸都失去了知觉。
